Maya: Mystery update: someone's foil hat was found on top of the office fridge. No context. No note. :tinfoil_hat: :eyes:
Jon: That was my prototype for 'cold lunch thermal stealth'. Totally legit.
Keisha: Quick poll: return to owner, leave as art, or inaugurate as office mascot? React :arrow_left: = return, :framed_picture: = art, :trophy: = mascot
Rolf: :framed_picture: That's a modern sculpture now.
Maya: Current reactions: :framed_picture: 1
Snack-Bot: Reminder: communal fridge items must be labeled. Hats excluded unless claimed.
Jon: One-liner contest: best caption for fridge-hat photo wins the last maple cookie. Keep it wholesome.
Keisha: "When your lunch is undercover."
Rolf: "Cold cuts, colder secrets." :smirk:
Maya: "Proof the sandwich was trying to reach the truth."
Jon: GIF of tiny detective cat.
Snack-Bot: Voting: Keisha +2 :thumbsup:, Rolf +1 :laughing:, Maya +1 :heart. Winner: Keisha. Maple cookie reserved.
Keisha: I accept this crumbly honour. Will also add a tiny label to the foil hat: 'Do not microwave.'
Maya: Plan: noon photo-op and gentle relocation to the 'art shelf' (aka top of the bookshelf). If owner appears, please claim politely.
Jon: If claimed, please present ID and a haiku about thermodynamics.
Rolf: Also proposing a tiny plaque: "Office Curiosities - Found Objects"
Maya: Agreed. Also, whoever put the hat there, please know your aesthetic is appreciated. :sparkles:
